[[Kanto Power Plant|Abandoned Power Plant]] }} '''Lapras Lazily''' (Japanese: '''VS ラプラス''' ''VS {{tt|Laplace|Lapras}}'') is the 50th chapter of the [[Pokémon Adventures]] manga, and the 10th chapter of the {{MangaArc|Yellow}}. ==Plot== {{spoilers}} {{adv|Blue}} begins to tell {{adv|Yellow}} what he was doing while {{adv|Red}} was battling {{adv|Giovanni}}. In a flashback, Blue is surfing across the sea on his {{TP|Blue|Golduck}}, when he gets attacked by a wild {{p|Lapras}}. After a short battle Blue catches the Lapras and heads to shore to check its [[Pokédex]] entry. As he does so, he is approached by a young boy who tells him to give his Lapras back. Blue comments that he shouldn't have been able to catch it if it belonged to another Trainer, to which the boy responds that he'd been tracking it for weeks. Blue points out that doesn't make it the boy's and begins to walk off, at which point the boy begs him for help. Later at a [[Pokémon Center]], Blue contacts {{adv|Professor Oak|his grandfather}} for advice, and is told that what the boy is saying is true. There are shadows that have been floating out of the [[Kanto Power Plant|abandoned Power Plant]], attracting {{type|Ghost}} Pokémon inside. Blue than says that he will accompany the boy to the Power Plant to get his {{p|Haunter}} back, and heads towards the site, where a wild {{p|Magnemite}} floats around and [[Agatha|an old lady]] stands, with Ghost Pokémon by her side. ==Major events== * Blue begins to tell {{adv|Yellow}} his story about before meeting {{adv|Red}} at the [[Indigo Plateau]]. * In a flashback, {{adv|Blue}} catches a {{p|Lapras}}. {{Adventuresevents}} {{endspoilers}} ===Debuts=== ====Pokémon debuts==== * {{p|Lapras}} ({{adv|Blue}}'s) * {{p|Haunter}} ==Characters== ===Humans=== * {{adv|Red}} (flashback) * {{adv|Blue}} (off panel pre-flashback; flashback) * {{adv|Yellow}} (off panel) * {{adv|Professor Oak}} (flashback) * {{adv|Giovanni}} (flashback) * [[Agatha]] (flashback; silhouette) * {{tc|Camper}} [[Evan]] (flashback) ===Pokémon=== * {{p|Golduck}} ({{OP|Blue|Golduck}}; flashback) * {{p|Lapras}} ({{adv|Blue}}'s; new; flashback) * {{p|Dugtrio}} ({{adv|Giovanni}}'s; flashback) * {{p|Nidoqueen}} ({{adv|Giovanni}}'s; flashback) * {{p|Rhyhorn}} ({{adv|Giovanni}}'s; flashback) * {{p|Gastly}} ([[Agatha]]'s; flashback) * {{p|Gengar}} ({{OP|Agatha|Gengar}}; ×2; flashback) * {{p|Haunter}} ([[Agatha]]'s; flashback) * {{p|Haunter}} ([[Evan]]'s; flashback) * {{p|Zapdos}} ([[Legendary birds (Adventures)|Adventures]]; flashback) * {{p|Magnemite}} (flashback) * {{p|Haunter}} (multiple; flashback) ===Other=== * {{OBP|Ghost|Pokémon Tower|Literal ghost}} (flashback) ==Trivia== ===Errors=== ==In other languages== {{Epilang|color={{yellow color light}}|bordercolor={{yellow color}} |zh_cmn={{tt|VS 乘龍|VS Lapras}} (Taiwan)
